title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Tea Party on 1969-12-30

ai_review.summary: High‑quality soundboard capture of a contemplative show featuring standout Black Peter and New Speedway, though missing sections of The Other One and Dark Star → Alligator affect the listening experience.
ai_review.review: The recording offers crisp, high‑fidelity soundboard audio that showcases a solid, introspective performance with memorable renditions of Black Peter, New Speedway, and The Other One. While one reviewer describes the set as sleepy, most praise its uniqueness and pre‑dawn vibe; however, technical glitches truncate the end of The Other One and portions of the Dark Star → Alligator transition.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality receives mixed feedback (some praise, some criticism) giving an approximate 3.5‑star rating, while the recording is generally good but has missing audio sections, yielding about a 4‑star rating. Weighted combination results in ~3.6 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear and high‑fidelity soundboard capture, but several track issues: The Other One missing its final 15–20 seconds and portions of Dark Star/Alligator are cut.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A contemplative, pre‑dawn set that some find unique and solid, though one listener felt it was a bit sleepy.
